title: "Personal Visualization Journey"
---

Add content here

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
step_count <- read_csv("pvj_data.csv")

step_count <- step_count |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date),
       steps = as.numeric(steps)) |>
  mutate(day_of_week = wday(date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)) |>
  select(date, day_of_week, steps) |> 
  filter(!is.na(steps))
```

```{r}
ggplot(step_count, aes(x = steps)) +
  geom_histogram(color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Number of Steps", x = "Steps", y = "Count")
```

```{r}
ggplot(step_count, aes(x = day_of_week, y = steps)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Steps by Day of the Week", 
       x = "Day of Week", 
       y = "Steps")
```

```{r}
ggplot(step_count, aes(x = date, y = steps, color = day_of_week)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Sunday" = "red", 
                              "Monday" = "orange", 
                              "Tuesday" = "yellow",
                              "Wednesday" = "green",
                              "Thursday" = "blue",
                              "Friday" = "purple",
                              "Saturday" = "magenta")) +
  labs(title = "Steps Over Time", 
       x = "Date", 
       y = "Number of Steps", 
       color = "Day of Week")
```
